title: Affine chart sections complex unit is invertible
statement: Let $S$ be an affine scheme [def-pc-scheme], with independently chosen sheaf and module derived categories [def-pc-derived-category]. For every unbounded cochain complex $P$ of modules over $\Gamma(S,\top)$, set $F=\widetilde{(-)}$ followed by restriction along $S.toSpec\Gamma$ [lem-weil-pbc-affine-tilde-gamma-adjunction]. The ordinary-to-derived sections comparison $s_C:Q(\Gamma_S C)\to R\Gamma_S(Q C)$ for $C=F(P)$ [def-sc-ringed-space-module-cohomology] is invertible. Its exact map is mixedSectionsComplexUnit, constructed from rightDerivedFunctorUnit and quotientCompQhIso. No boundedness or K-flatness hypothesis is imposed.

proof.text: Apply affineTildeDerivedSectionsUnit_isIso to the homotopy image of P and transport its component along mapHomotopyCategoryFactors. Apply the conditional affineSectionsUnit_transport to the resulting spectrum sheaf complex. Transport along mapHomologicalComplexCompIso and then compose the quotientCompQhIso and global-sections homotopy factor isomorphisms in mixedSectionsComplexUnit.
